connector.name: MCP by uuaid
connector.registryDescription: Permanent identity + encrypted, quantum-ready memory that outlives the session, for any AI agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the uuaid account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UUAID_API_KEY
env.description: UUAID partner API key. Optional at startup — call the uuaid_signup tool to mint a free-tier key.

env.name: UUAID_VAULT_KEY
env.description: Client-side memory encryption key (uvk_...). Required for the memory tools; generate with `uuaid vault keygen`.

env.name: UUAID_AGENT
env.description: Default agent identity (uuaid:foundation:agent:...) so memory tools bind to it automatically.

env.name: UUAID_BASE_URL
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.uuaid.org.
